--- text
The quick brown fox jumps ov|er the lazy dog
--- width
20
--- keys
Down Up
--- expect
The quick brown fox jumps ov|er the lazy dog
--- note
The target-column invariant across a soft wrap. Down clamps to the short
last row, Up must return to the column the run started from, not to the
column the clamp landed on. This is the 'Down doesn't go where I aimed'
report in its simplest form.
